description: evals/margin/scripts/run-smoke.sh builds the tether wheel, stamps its version as 0.1.0+g<sha7> (by sed on pyproject.toml), and writes tether-build.json (ref/commit/branch/wheel/built_at) into the run dir. evals/margin/scripts/verify-smoke.py reads tether-build.json (commit/ref/branch/wheel) and cross-checks each instance's stamped version against +g<commit first 7 chars>. If run-smoke.sh changes the stamp format or renames a tether-build.json field the verifier reads, verify-smoke.py silently mis-reports or fails the version cross-check; the two scripts must move together.
